让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。
3D modeling in Python, built for LLMs.

Autonomous pentest legion — AI commander + worker swarm + layered fact-intent graph. 3rd Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense online champion (634 teams · 8h unattended · 1B tokens beat 4.5B). The Nüwa Test: give AIs Create/Language/History, let a civilization grow.
Muse4AI — let your AI agent make the pictures and the videos. Local Windows bridge for Muse via REST, MCP, and OAuth.
Agent skill: describe your stack in a sentence, get an architecture diagram with official logos
Films made with code. Short films, long YouTube videos, ads, explainers and music videos: an AI coding agent writes the script, builds every frame in code, designs the sound and hands you an MP4.
A GPU task manager for Windows, Linux, and WSL: per-process VRAM, GPU activity, and LLM model/KV-cache insights (Windows AMD and NVIDIA).
医学论文写作与科研助手：面向中国医生和医学研究生的 32 个 Agent Skills，适用于 Claude Code、Codex，覆盖选题、PubMed 文献检索、中英写作、选刊投稿与审稿修回。Medical writing & research skills.
Ultra-low-cost robotic joint: a $1.5 FOC board inside a 1503 gimbal motor, plus a 3D-printed high-ratio precision gearbox. Cheap power, exact motion.
